raw_response:
I'm 49 this year, been farming these 12 mu since I was a teenager. My old man taught me, and his old man taught him. I never went to school, don't need books to know when the soil is ready.

Cotton is what I know. Every year around April 20th, I plant. Old Wang down the road planted early last year and lost half his seedlings to the cold. I'm not stupid, I wait until the earth warms up proper.

I buy hybrid seed from the county shop, about 45 yuan a mu. Costs money, but my own saved seed got weaker and weaker, yield dropped bad. Learned that lesson ten years ago.

For fertilizer, I spread one bag of that compound stuff per mu before planting — the 50-jin bags, scatter it by hand walking the field. Then in July when the flowers come, I topdress with half a bag of urea per mu. Some neighbors use more, but fertilizer got expensive and I don't have cash to throw around. Just me and my wife, we eat what the land gives us, can't risk running out of money for medicine or emergencies.

Water — I'll run the pump twice. Once after planting if spring stays dry, and again when it's flowering. Diesel for the pump isn't cheap. Last year I watered three times and the electric bill near killed me. If the rains come, I might skip the second one.

Weeds and worms, I spray three times. Herbicide before the cotton comes up, then insecticide when I see the leaves getting holes. I don't mess around with worms — one bad year and you lose everything.

Tillage, I hire Old Li's tractor to plow when the ground thaws and harrow it smooth before planting. Costs 40 yuan a mu. Rest I do myself.

Labor — my wife and me do everything except the picking. Cotton picking, 12 mu is too much for two people. I hire the village women, pay them 80 or 90 yuan a day. Twenty-five days spread across September and October. It costs, but what choice do I have? If we don't pick in time, the bolls open and the cotton gets dirty, price drops.

I figure we'll get about 520 jin per mu if the weather holds — not the best, not the worst. Last year was a bit better, but you never know.

Total cost this year, I'm figuring about 7,100 yuan. Seed, fertilizer, pesticide, diesel for water, tractor hire, hired pickers. It eats up most of what I made last year, but that's farming. You spend it to make it.
